name: Güvenlik Tunnel
facts: The Güvenlik Tunnel, opened in 2008, stretches 1,835 meters, carving a single tube that carries one lane of traffic in each direction through the Pontic Mountains.
Built on the Tirebolu–Gümüşhane state highway D.877, the tunnel links the Black Sea Region directly with Eastern Anatolia, dramatically shortening travel time between the two areas.
Situated near Güvenlik village in Doğankent district, the tunnel’s construction exemplifies Turkey’s commitment to modernizing infrastructure in challenging mountainous terrain.
